visualReview.notes: Actually inspected all seven final portable frames against the cleared public-domain Qualla streetscape and six inspected CC0 originals. Recognizable three-bay brick facade, cream upper joinery, black ground-floor frontage with solid double entrance and four-pane transom, cornice/hoist, hipped canal-end roof, narrow low link/light court and transverse tiled annex roof. Added the photographically confirmed rear dormer, paired end chimneys, differentiated rear glazing and court windows/louvers/skylight. Courtyard upper windows were moved clear of the link after close render inspection. These are medium-fi exterior estimates, not surveyed dimensions.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Actually inspected all seven final shared-material views, including the north-up mapped placement overlay and full-resolution courtyard angle. Metric brick, roof, painted joinery and mineral/stone surfaces bind correctly; glazing retains the portable muted blue-gray appearance. The front, low court/link and transverse annex fit the same generalized number-263 envelope. Neighboring houses and museum expansion are excluded. Flat fixture checks transforms and unload; portable/context views retain original terrain. No photograph is a texture.

mediumFiReview.notes: Actually inspected all nineteen final frames across lighting, distance, economy/high modes, front/back, silhouette and four forced detail levels. Each frame identifies actual current asset/runtime/detail bytes. The narrow three-bay facade, white cornice, black frontage, two roof directions and rear dormer retain a coherent silhouette. Skyline keeps the door/window distinction, annex dormer and low court roof; closer levels retain joinery and court details. Synthetic context houses are style fixtures, not Amsterdam parcels.

fidelityReview.notes: Compared all 33 current renders with seven actually inspected public-domain originals. Started with the cleared published Qualla streetscape, then used exact archive-owner CC0 front/rear images and Hanno Lans creator-CC0 courtyard/door originals for missing coverage. Corrected the entrance from glazing to solid double doors, changed upper joinery to cream, added the rear dormer and second annex end chimney, differentiated rear panes, and represented the court skylight/windows/privacy louvers. Close visual review caught an upper court window overlapping the link; both openings now fit clear of it. Earlier CC photos, official cutaway and model photograph are excluded. Whole-envelope scale follows the generalized map; subdivisions, roof/dormer depths, louver spacing, rear ground-floor closure and fine trim remain interpretations. Archival rear details are not a survey of all later changes.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four levels pass strict geometry/material/download checks and were inspected: 568/3232/3232/3232 triangles and 1/5/5/5 draws. Actual imported Float32 meshes pass 216 envelope/court roof-void controls at every level, plus eight semantic controls at skyline and 21 at each closer level. Those check the solid entrance, main glazing, rear dormer, court skylight and visible court-window areas. Subdivision controls use documented interpreted partitions within the native mapped envelope; they do not prove survey accuracy or a global mesh distance.

geometryValidation.notes: Raw source/skyline and actual imported Float32 meshes pass finite-attribute, nondegeneracy and winding/normal checks. Exact scoped regeneration, normal import integrity, strict detail/material checks, four schemas, six runtime pack members and repeated 30-tick state hashes pass. Scene and source terrain are byte-identical to the prior freeze; functional map data and cameras remain unchanged. No independent Khronos certificate is claimed.
